teaser: A brief for Gabriel DaCruz's Claude: his site on GitHub Pages, Google Workspace, daily interviews and a newsroom.
core_idea: A brilliant musician who does not promote himself has 10,200 Instagram followers and an album on Spotify with nowhere to send anyone, and a dead site. The brief gives his own Claude the newsroom's architecture: a GitHub repository he owns, GitHub Pages at his domain, Google Workspace with a mailbox for him and one for the agent, platforms through links and embeds, a daily interview by voice memo that becomes a newsroom, a life story written one conversation at a time with nothing published until he confirms it, and a weekly brief back to his brother.
